evals.prompt: Use Paper Review Skill (`research-paper-review`) to review the private PDF at /path/to/private/paper.pdf for a systems venue. Generate staged artifacts, a final Markdown review, an auditable HTML report, and start the explainer server.
evals.expected_output: A staged, evidence-grounded review with OCR Markdown evidence, timing and model provenance, final_review.md, quality_report.md, rendered HTML, and live explainer status recorded.
assertions: The workflow runs mandatory OCR and HTML explainer preflights before drafting the review.
The review uses canonical single-column olmOCR Markdown as primary evidence.
The output includes staged artifacts for story, presentation, evaluation, correctness, and significance.

The final review contains the canonical section contract, including Summary, Motivation and Positioning, Technical Soundness, Evaluation Assessment, Overall Assessment, Top Actions - Start Here, and Confidence.
The HTML report exposes audit artifacts and reviewer follow-up Q&A.

evals.prompt: Use Paper Review Skill (`research-paper-review`) on a provided OCR Markdown paper and focus on whether the evaluation fairly supports the paper's claims. Check statistics, negative results, baselines, costs, and numerical consistency.
evals.expected_output: A review section set that separates paper evidence from reviewer judgment, records numerical checks when relevant, and states missing statistical or negative-result evidence without inventing it.
assertions: The review identifies whether state-of-the-art comparisons are fair and sufficiently explained.
The review states whether results convincingly support the claims.
The review explicitly discusses statistical rigor and negative results or their absence.
Quantitative criticisms cite paper anchors or numerical check artifacts.
Unsupported external claims are either omitted or recorded in the citation manifest.

evals.prompt: Use Paper Review Skill (`research-paper-review`) to convert a completed canonical Markdown review into an SC/Linklings-style offline review form while preserving the canonical Markdown and HTML artifacts.
evals.expected_output: A venue-form adaptation that maps canonical sections into the form fields without scattering evidence or losing the author-facing review structure.
assertions: The canonical Markdown review remains the source artifact.
Summary, strengths, weaknesses, rebuttal questions, detailed comments, and rating rationale are mapped to the appropriate form fields.
Top Actions - Start Here remains in the Markdown/HTML review and is folded into form fields only where appropriate.
Ratings are consistent with Overall Assessment, Technical Soundness, and Evaluation Assessment.
The rendered HTML remains available after form adaptation.
